title: Two soldiers — God’s armor and the devil’s
english: [[The wicked draw the sword and bend their bow >> Bible:Psalm 37:14]]. Picture two soldiers: God’s wears the [[breastplate of righteousness >> Bible:Ephesians 6:14]] and [[helmet of salvation >> Bible:Ephesians 6:17]]; the devil’s man wears injustice and ruin.

title: Infants not yet armed either way
english: Only those who can already sin wear either armor — infants not yet. Glory to God. Amen.
